PART 1 – GENERAL

1.1 SCOPE

A. This section covers grounding and bonding for communications systems.

  1. All work shall comply with applicable standards.

1.2 REFERENCES

A. ANSI/TIA-607-C Commercial Building Grounding standard.

PART 2 – PRODUCTS

2.1 MATERIALS

A. Copper busbars per ANSI-J-STD-607-A.

  1. Minimum 6mm thickness.

2.2 FABRICATION

A. Factory fabricated assemblies only.

PART 3 – EXECUTION

3.1 INSTALLATION

A. Install per manufacturer instructions.

  1. Torque connections to specified values.

3.2 FIELD QUALITY CONTROL

A. Verify continuity after installation.
